entities.summary: Lars-Göran Ivarsson is an ice hockey player who played for the Swedish national team. He won a bronze medal at the 1988 Winter Olympics. He played for Brynäs from 1984 until 1988, for HV71 from 1988 until 1993 and for Vasteras IK from 1978 until 1984, 1994–1997. And for KaiPa from 1997 to 1998.
